clueDescriptions.description: A broken window with cookie crumbs on it
clueDescriptions.dialog: Looking closer, I see the window is covered in more cookie crumbs. Why would a thief throw a stolen cookie into a window?

clueDescriptions.description: A trail of cookie crumbs leading to the shoe shop
clueDescriptions.dialog: The trail leads all the way to the shoe shop. The thief must be inside.
The door is locked. How did the thief get inside?

clueDescriptions.description: A pedestal with cookie crumbs on it that used to hold baby shoes
clueDescriptions.dialog: It looks like there used to be something on this pedestal. And it's covered in cookie crumbs now.

flow.CharacterDescription: Ms. Baker is a friendly baker at dreary lane bakery. She made a giant cookie last night and is worried about it. The last time she saw her cookie was when it was cooling on a baking pan, hot out of the oven. Unless asked twice, she won't say why it is important for her cookie to be found. First time she will push off the question, saying that's not important. If asked again, she will say that she spilt some magic ingredients on the cookie that a witch gave her. She won't say why she visited a witch. She thinks that the king stole her cookie because he is always asking her to make more.

flow.text: Tell me about your last adventure Ms. Baker. What happened? Look I added a sthirsa line here. HOpefully I can see it.

scenes.text: It is worth it because I am protecting all my friends.
I protect my city by searching for clues.
I protect my city by searching for clues.
Today, I was visiting the Drury Lane Bakery, for my daily Muffin.
When I heard a loud cry for help from Betsy the baker.
Leo saved the day! The cookies are safe once again.
Sometimes I have to fight the monsters.

clueDescriptions.dialog: A bowl of hair. Why would a baker have a bowl of human hair?
That's not dirt on the ground. I take a finger and lick it. Yes it tastes quite sugary with a strong cinnamon flavor.

clueDescriptions.description: A witch's potion bottle, half empty
clueDescriptions.dialog: This looks like a witch's potion. And it's half empty. What was Ms. Butterbuns doing with a potion?
It looks like Ms. Butterbuns was making cookies with white frosting.
